description: Renode - Antmicro's open source simulation and virtual development framework for complex embedded systems.
notes: Renode requires .NET (dotnet) >= 10.0. This package is the portable build with the .NET runtime bundled, so dotnet need not be installed separately.
The other dependencies listed in the README are for Linux only.
Robot Framework testing: to write and run test cases, Renode integrates with the Robot testing framework. This requires Python 3 with pip ('scoop install python').
Once you have Python 3 and pip, install the additional modules:
Other tools: each of the tools in the 'tools' subdirectory may contain a 'requirements.txt' file separate from Renode's requirements.
Install them in your virtual environment with 'pip install -r requirements.txt'.
